padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the card padding inline (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap card: 12px on all four sides).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the card padding block (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap card: 12px on all four sides).

gap.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the card stack gap between icon, text and actions (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap gap Space/xl 12px).

text-gap.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the heading-to-message stack gap (MarsUI Text_wrap 4px, decoupled from the outer 12px card gap).

radius.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the card radius (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap big_component/radius_xs 16px; the shell around it has its own radius).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the card border width (MarsUI never strokes alert surfaces: the Alert master card stroke is fully transparent. material3 keeps its 2px border via its override).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the alert component for font size.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the alert component for line height.

message-line-height.$description: dimension used by the alert component for message line height (MarsUI description is 13/20 line_height/para; the heading keeps 15/24).

heading-font-family.$description: Font family for the alert heading. Override it to give alerts their own heading typeface.

heading-font-size.$description: dimension used by the alert component for heading font size.

heading-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the alert component for heading font weight (MarsUI UI/Body 2/medium: weight 600 on the master heading).

dismiss-size.$description: dimension used by the alert component for dismiss size.

dismiss-icon-size.$description: dimension used by the alert component for dismiss icon size (Figma close glyph box 16px inside the 24px raised circle; repointed from 18px per the fidelity audit).

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the neutral card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone; the tone is drawn on the icon. Other themes may tint the card per tone here).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the neutral card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

border.$description: color used by the alert component for neutral border.

icon-bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the neutral icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/primary-base-em-alpha at 12%: the master variable itself, not the heavier primary-tint content fill, so the primary glyph clears 4.5:1 in dark).

icon-fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the neutral icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/primary-high-em).

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the success card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone; the tone is drawn on the icon. Other themes may tint the card per tone here).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the success card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

border.$description: color used by the alert component for success border (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface).

icon-bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the success icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/success-base-em-alpha at 12%).

icon-fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the success icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/success-high-em).

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the danger card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone; the tone is drawn on the icon. Other themes may tint the card per tone here).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the danger card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

border.$description: color used by the alert component for danger border (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface).

icon-bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the danger icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/danger-base-em-alpha at 12%).

icon-fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the danger icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/danger-high-em).

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the info card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone; the tone is drawn on the icon. Other themes may tint the card per tone here).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the info card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

border.$description: color used by the alert component for info border (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface).

icon-bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the info icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/info-base-em-alpha at 12%).

icon-fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the info icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/info-high-em).

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the warning card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone; the tone is drawn on the icon. Other themes may tint the card per tone here).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the warning card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

border.$description: color used by the alert component for warning border (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface).

icon-bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the warning icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/warning-base-em-alpha at 12%).

icon-fg.$description: color used by the alert component for the warning icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/warning-high-em).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the dismiss chip bevel stroke (MarsUI 24px raised circle: 1px Outline/secondary_button_top hairline).

radius.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the dismiss chip shape (MarsUI Radius/radius_round full circle).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for dismiss rest foreground.
color used by the alert component for dismiss hover foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for dismiss hover background (MarsUI hover mechanism: hover_overlay_inverse Black/3 wash — the dismiss chip previously had zero visible hover change).

fg.$description: color used by the alert component for dismiss active foreground.

color.$description: color used by the alert component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the alert component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the alert component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the alert dismiss control for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).

padding.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the shell padding around the card (MarsUI Alert master: 12px on all four sides).

radius.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the shell radius (MarsUI Alert master big_component/radius_lg 28px).

bg.$description: color used by the alert component for the shell wash (MarsUI Alert master Inverse-white/alpha-2: the nearest step of the Kimen inverse-white ramp, Black/3 light and White/3 dark).

backdrop-blur.$description: backdrop blur used by the alert component behind the shell (MarsUI Alert master BACKGROUND_BLUR Blur/24 = CSS 12px; reduced transparency and material3 resolve to blur none through the semantic token).

shadow.$description: shadow used by the alert component for the card elevation (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap: elevation ramp level e5).

size.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon size xs: 32px).

radius.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the icon frame radius (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon: a circle).

glyph-size.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the icon glyph inside the frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph 20px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the alert component for the gap between slotted actions (MarsUI Alert master CTAs gap Space/xl 12px).
